fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.
findings: Light-colored rubber floor mat in the rear footwell looks dusty and dirty in the grooves
Gray leather rear bench shows light scuffing and soil on the seat bottom
Kick-protector covers on the back of the front seats look dusty and worn
Black plastic rear bumper step and bed rail caps look faded and grayish
Bed liner surface is dusty with some debris
White paint looks clean but somewhat flat rather than glossy on the hood and doors
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ridgeline. The white paint looks good overall, but the rear floor mat and leather back seat look a bit dusty, and the black rear bumper step has faded some. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including interior cleaning, a wash and wax, and black trim restoration. Would you like a quote?
